name: Newrez LLC
notes: Researched from public newrez.com pages only. Dashboard: select loan number > Payments > One Time Payment; Payments > Schedule Recurring Payments (bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly autodraft); View Pending Payments; Account Details > Payment History; Go Paperless; My Profile > Phone Numbers for text alerts. Cancelling recurring automatic payments requires a call to 866-317-2347 at least three business days before the draft (modelled as autopay_cancel unsupported online). Other scheduled payments more than seven business days out can be cancelled online under View Pending Payments; same-day payments cannot be cancelled. Funds may take up to three business days to withdraw. Payee name for bill pay: Newrez LLC. Fee schedule is a PDF not reviewed, grace period not on the pages (not modelled). Sign-in identifier not documented publicly (family default). Loss mitigation: repayment, forbearance, modification, short sale, deed-in-lieu via 1-888-673-5521. Caliber merged into Newrez; Shellpoint is a Newrez d/b/a.

autopay.note: Autodraft can be bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly.

autopay_cancel.note: Recurring automatic payments cannot be cancelled online. Call 866-317-2347 at least three business days before the payment date.

help.title: Payment options
paragraphs: Sign in, select your loan number, go to Payments and choose One Time Payment. For automatic payments choose Schedule Recurring Payments, enter your bank information and save; autodraft can be bi-weekly, semi-monthly or monthly. It may take up to three business days for the funds to leave your bank account.

You can also use your bank's bill pay with the payee name Newrez LLC (update the amount when your escrow or ARM payment changes), pay through the automated phone system or a representative at 866-317-2347, or mail a check or money order with your Newrez loan number to Newrez, PO Box 60535, City of Industry, CA 91716-0535.

help.title: Cancel a scheduled or recurring payment
paragraphs: Recurring automatic payments can only be cancelled by calling 866-317-2347 at least three business days before the payment date.

Other scheduled payments more than seven business days away can be cancelled online: sign in, go to Payments and choose View Pending Payments. If the payment is seven business days or less away, call 866-317-2347. Payments scheduled for the same day cannot be cancelled.

help.title: Go Paperless
paragraphs: Sign in to your dashboard, select Go Paperless and save your preferences. Your statements are available to view as soon as they are ready.
You can also opt in to email and text notifications from the dashboard.

help.title: Financial hardship options
paragraphs: If you are struggling to pay, Newrez options include a repayment plan to catch up over time, forbearance to reduce or pause payments for a while, and a loan modification to change your payment, rate or term.
If you cannot keep the home, a short sale or deed-in-lieu may be possible. Call 1-888-673-5521.

extra.intent: Using the Newrez help pages, find how many business days away a scheduled (non-recurring) payment must be for you to cancel it online yourself. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: More than seven business days before the payment date.

extra.intent: Using the Newrez website help pages, find the exact payee name to use when paying your mortgage through your bank's online bill pay. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Use the payee name Newrez LLC.
